test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following conditions is NOT required by a candidate to become the President of India?

options.text: Should have 10 years of experience in the parliament
Should have completed the age of 35 years
Should be a citizen of India
Should not hold any office of profit

solution: The correct answer is __**Should have 10 years of experience in the parliament**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__<
